name: @broberg/media
description: The fleet's provider-agnostic media-storage facade — one createMedia() API (upload · get · signedUrl · delete · publicUrl) over swappable storage providers, so a later move between providers never touches a call-site. Ships a Cloudflare R2 provider (S3-compatible, SigV4 via aws4fetch — Node/Bun/edge) and a VOLUME provider for an app that already has a durable disk (a Fly volume, a bind mount) and serves the bytes itself. Multi-tenant keyPrefix, EU-jurisdiction, path-traversal refusals. Start on a volume or R2; swap by changing one config object.
